AT0107.title: Flipper Zero
AT0107.description:
Flipper Zero is a portable multi-protocol hardware and wireless security-research device with Sub-GHz radio, 125 kHz RFID, NFC, infrared, iButton, and USB interfaces. Its official firmware can read, save, and emulate selected supported remote-control and credential signals, and provides frequency analysis, RAW signal recording, and BadUSB script execution for authorized testing of access-control, remote-control, and IoT devices.

In unauthorized use, an attacker may use it to copy low-security RFID credentials, record and replay fixed-code wireless access signals, test weak protocols, or emulate USB keyboard input. Its capabilities remain limited by radio regulations, protocol support, encryption, and rolling-code design; possession of the device does not imply an ability to defeat every wireless access-control or dynamic-credential system.
